import Mathlib

example (a b : ℕ) (ha : Even a) (hb : Even b) : Even (a + b) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hb
  use x + y
  rw [hx, hy]
  ring
